mainEntity.name: How long does finish carpentry coordination typically add to a project timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration finish carpentry coordination adds to a project timeline varies depending on the project's size, complexity, and the scope of finish work. For smaller projects, it might be a few days to weeks, while larger, more intricate projects could involve several weeks or even months. Proper planning and efficient coordination aim to minimize any added time by integrating it seamlessly into the overall schedule.
